{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Malachite Scent''''' was a royal [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]] [[Star Cruiser/Legends|star cruiser]] that was lost along the [[Anoat trade corridor]] shortly before the fall of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. The notorious [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Clabburn the Elder]] made off with the vast treasures found on board the ship, which was his final raid before disappearing for good.
